ftb.guhs_guheinde.q.einde2_sp_d1_start_r: Whoever has finished the Guhvatar story gets mail in the Guh End: a &bsoap bubble&r with a letter inside floats up to you. Click it!
Blow for &dAppa&r and fly to &bBikini Bottom&r. Land on the little island on top of the big soap bubble.
Step into the &bbubble stream&r: it sets you down gently on the square of Bikini Bottom, where someone very square is waiting for you.
Apply with &6Mr. Krabguh&r at &6The Krusty Nibble&r. Don't bring money: he keeps it.
Spongeguh teaches you the trade. Bake &6five Nibble Patties&r in the order on the ticket. Nobody hurries you.
gui.guhs.einde2_sp_d1_start.bakken.bel: Ding! Order %1$s of %2$s: look at the ticket above the grill
gui.guhs.einde2_sp_d1_start.bakken.gesto: Baking stopped. Go back behind the grill to bake on (your orders still count).
gui.guhs.einde2_sp_d1_start.bakken.klant: Table 1: a hungry Bikini Bottom guh
Table 2: a guh with a hat (extra cheese, please)
Table 3: a guh who wants "something green"
Table 1: a guh who likes it sour
Patguh, through the window: DOUBLE! Double double!
gui.guhs.einde2_sp_d1_start.bakken.naar_: Stand behind the grill, in the light beam
gui.guhs.einde2_sp_d1_start.bakken.plof: Flop! That wasn't on the ticket. No harm done: this order again.
gui.guhs.einde2_sp_d1_start.bakken.plof_: Tip: the arrow on the ticket points at the part that goes on now. You never lose anything.
gui.guhs.einde2_sp_d1_start.bakken.regel: Click the crates in the order on the ticket
gui.guhs.einde2_sp_d1_start.bakken.tijd: Your time: %1$s (your best: %2$s). Just for fun: there was no hurry.
Your time: %1$s. That's your best time so far!
gui.guhs.einde2_sp_d1_start.bakken.verde: You had %1$s of the %2$s orders done already. Bake on!
gui.guhs.einde2_sp_d1_start.beloning.pet: You got the Krusty Nibble Cap! Clothes for your guhs, nyeg.
gui.guhs.einde2_sp_d1_start.brief.komt: A soap bubble is floating your way... with a letter inside!
gui.guhs.einde2_sp_d1_start.brief.meldin: A glittering soap bubble with a letter inside floats up to you. Click it to pop it.
gui.guhs.einde2_sp_d1_start.brief.weg: The bubble letter drifts off for a bit... it'll be back soon, nyeg.
gui.guhs.einde2_sp_d1_start.hint.brief: A soap bubble with a letter is floating your way, somewhere in the Guh End. Click it when you see it!
gui.guhs.einde2_sp_d1_start.hint.bubbel: Step into the bubble stream: the glittering column in the tube in the middle of the little island (%s). The entrance is on the south side. It sets you down gently on the square of Bikini Bottom.
gui.guhs.einde2_sp_d1_start.hint.grill: Leave the office and take the door all the way left in the back wall of the restaurant: the kitchen. Stand behind the grill (%s), in the light beam. Spongeguh is waiting for you.
gui.guhs.einde2_sp_d1_start.hint.knabbel: Walk along Main Street to The Krusty Nibble (%s): the building with the round roof. Go inside, through the door at the back on the right into the office, and click Mr. Krabguh.
gui.guhs.einde2_sp_d1_start.hint.reis: Off to Bikini Bottom (%s)! Blow your Appa Whistle and pick Bikini Bottom in his list, or follow the Super Compass (the end tab). Land on the little island on top of the big soap bubble.
gui.guhs.einde2_sp_d1_start.praat.bakken: Bake! Every second you chat costs me a nibble!
I hear the bell. I ignore the bell. That's how it works here.
Daddy says you bake really fast. Well, he said: not too slow.
Is it jellyfishing time yet? No? ...And now?
Look at the ticket above the grill! The arrow points at what goes on now. Bun first!
gui.guhs.einde2_sp_d1_start.praat.voor.b: Welcome to Bikini Bottom! The mist is purple, but very healthy.
Have you tried the Nibble Patty yet? I eat three a day. Or five. Who's counting?
Watch out for Plankmika, the little one. He always wants the secret recipe, nyeg.
gui.guhs.einde2_sp_d1_start.praat.voor.g: Nyeg. (Gary looks at you as if he already knows everything.)
gui.guhs.einde2_sp_d1_start.praat.voor.j: Someone new in town? Can you drive a boat? No? Thank goodness, nyeg.
gui.guhs.einde2_sp_d1_start.praat.voor.m: A customer! Or... no? Here for the job? Then you're late! No, wait, you're right on time!
gui.guhs.einde2_sp_d1_start.praat.voor.o: No, I'm not the boss. Yes, I am unhappy. The office is at the back.
Squilliam, charmed. Rich, handsome, and I play the clarinet better than Squidmika. Do tell him.
gui.guhs.einde2_sp_d1_start.praat.voor.p: Daddy is always looking for staff. He pays in nibbles. Very small nibbles.
Working? I worked once too. It was terrible. I lay awake for a quarter of an hour.
The secret recipe... one day it will be MINE! Mwahahaha. Ahem. Good afternoon, new citizen.
gui.guhs.einde2_sp_d1_start.praat.voor.s: Howdy! I'm Sandy Guh. I live here in an air dome. Long story. Very long story.
Mr. Krabguh is in his office, at the back on the right! Don't knock though, that costs a nibble.
gui.guhs.einde2_sp_d1_start.sollicitatie: Click Mr. Krabguh (right-click) for your job interview
gui.guhs.kledingbron.einde2_sp_d1_start: Spongeguh story: your job interview at The Krusty Nibble
gui.guhs.verhaal.kaart.einde2_sp_d1_star: Ah, Bikini Bottom. Deep below the outer islands of the Guh End lies a dish of cheese rind, under a soap bubble as big as a mountain.
There live Spongeguh Cheesepants, his very best friend Patguh Star and Gary the snail, who only ever says "nyeg". But with feeling.
And there stands The Krusty Nibble, where Mr. Krabguh sells the tastiest burger of the Guh End. The recipe? Secret, of course.
Today someone starts a new job there. Guess who, mon ami.
gui.guhs.verhalen.sponsguh_recept.kort.4: Follow the ticket above the grill
gui.guhs.verhalen.sponsguh_recept.nu.0: A soap bubble with a letter inside is floating your way, somewhere in the Guh End (it finds you, no need to search). Click it to pop it.
gui.guhs.verhalen.sponsguh_recept.nu.1: Blow your Appa Whistle and pick Bikini Bottom in his list, or follow the Super Compass (the end tab). Land on the little island on top of the big soap bubble, deep between the outer islands.
gui.guhs.verhalen.sponsguh_recept.nu.2: On the little island, step into the bubble stream: the glittering column in the tube in the middle, its entrance is on the south side. It sets you down gently on the square of Bikini Bottom.
gui.guhs.verhalen.sponsguh_recept.nu.3: Walk east from the square along Main Street to The Krusty Nibble (the building with the round roof). Go inside, through the door at the back on the right into the office, and click Mr. Krabguh.
gui.guhs.verhalen.sponsguh_recept.nu.4: In the kitchen of The Krusty Nibble, stand behind the grill (the door all the way left in the back wall). Click the crates in the order on the ticket above the grill. Five orders and you are a real nibble cook.
gui.guhs.verhalen.sponsguh_recept.nu.4_b: Start baking! Look at the ticket above the grill (the arrow points at the part that goes on now) and click that crate. Wrong? Flop, and just do that order again.
gui.guhs.verhalen.sponsguh_recept.waar.0: Anywhere in the Guh End (the bubble finds you)
gui.guhs.verhalen.sponsguh_recept.waar.1: The little island on top of the soap bubble of Bikini Bottom, deep between the outer islands
gui.guhs.verhalen.sponsguh_recept.waar.2: The bubble stream in the middle of the little island, down to the square
gui.guhs.verhalen.sponsguh_recept.waar.3: Mr. Krabguh's office, at the back of The Krusty Nibble (east of the square)
gui.guhs.verhalen.sponsguh_recept.waar.4: The grill in the kitchen of The Krusty Nibble
The grill in the kitchen of The Krusty Nibble
scene.guhs.einde2_sp_d1_start_aankomst.b: That glittering column in the middle of the island is the bubble stream. Step in and it sets you down gently on the square. No lift in the world is this soft, nyeg.
scene.guhs.einde2_sp_d1_start_aankomst.e: Ah, there it is: a little island on top of an enormous soap bubble. And what lies underneath? Have a look, mon ami.
scene.guhs.einde2_sp_d1_start_aankomst.k: And there, with the round roof: The Krusty Nibble, Mr. Krabguh's restaurant. They are looking for a nibble cook... and that's you.
scene.guhs.einde2_sp_d1_start_aankomst.s: Bikini Bottom! Purple mist for sea water, flower clouds for lamps and a floor of crispy cheese rind. Everyone knows everyone. And almost everyone is sweet.
scene.guhs.einde2_sp_d1_start_bakken_kla: Hey! Hey! Are you done baking? I've got nets! Come JELLYFISHING! I'll wait at my rock! Come on, come on, come on!
FIVE! Five perfect Nibble Patties! You're a natural! A nibble prodigy! A... I've run out of words!
Sigh. Wonderful. Now there are two of them.
scene.guhs.einde2_sp_d1_start_bakken_uit: A customer rings at a table, and then a ticket floats above the grill. It shows the burger, from the bottom up. The arrow points at what goes on now.
Something wrong on it? Flop, the burger falls flat. No harm done, just start over! There's no hurry, only love. Five orders and you're a real nibble cook.
Welcome to the kitchen! And this... is the grill. Say hi to the grill. He's my best friend. After Patguh. And Gary.
Around the grill stand five crates: bun, patty, cheese, sea lettuce and pickle. Click a crate and that part goes on the burger. Exactly in the order on the ticket!
I'm so proud. I need to cry for a moment. No, later. Baking first!
scene.guhs.einde2_sp_d1_start_brief.biki: Ah, Bikini Bottom... A little town deep below the outer islands, under a soap bubble as big as a mountain. They bake the tastiest burger of the whole Guh End there. Allez, off you go!
scene.guhs.einde2_sp_d1_start_brief.eise: What you need: two hands, two little ears and a heart full of nibbles. Guhvatars welcome too! I've already laid out an apron for you. Nyeg!
scene.guhs.einde2_sp_d1_start_brief.plop: Pop! The soap bubble bursts. A little letter flutters out, still a bit wet from the soap.
scene.guhs.einde2_sp_d1_start_brief.vaca: Hello, hello, HELLO! This is Spongeguh Cheesepants, with a JOB OPENING! The Krusty Nibble in Bikini Bottom is looking for a new nibble cook!
scene.guhs.einde2_sp_d1_start_kijk_bubbe: The bubble stream: step in, the entrance is on the south side.
scene.guhs.einde2_sp_d1_start_kijk_knabb: The Krusty Nibble, on Main Street.
scene.guhs.einde2_sp_d1_start_sollicitat: HIRED! Here's your Krusty Nibble Cap. The cap comes out of your first paycheck. Just kidding! ...Half kidding.
Spongeguh is in the kitchen, at the back on the left. He'll teach you the trade. Off to the grill! The customers are hungry and their nibbles are burning a hole in their pockets!
You nod. You don't quite know why yourself.
Huh?! Who's there? A customer? No... a JOB SEEKER! Sit down. No, stand. Sitting costs extra.
Eight hundred ninety-eight... eight hundred ninety-nine... NINE HUNDRED nibbles! Come to papa, my shiny little darlings.
First question: do you know what a nibble is? Exactly: money! Second question: do you like working very hard for very, very few nibbles?
Sigh. Another cheerful one. Just what this place needed: more cheer.
scene.guhs.einde2_sp_d1_start_welkom.ger: That's Gary, my snail. He says you look very capable. And that he's hungry. He always says that.
scene.guhs.einde2_sp_d1_start_welkom.hal: HELLO! Is it you? It's you! It's really you! The new nibble cook!
scene.guhs.einde2_sp_d1_start_welkom.ik_: I'm Spongeguh Cheesepants! Square, full of holes, and Employee of the Week nine hundred weeks in a row!
scene.guhs.einde2_sp_d1_start_welkom.mee: Come on, come on! Mr. Krabguh is waiting in The Krusty Nibble, just east of here on Main Street! He loves new staff. And money. Mostly money.
scene.guhs.einde2_sp_d1_start_welkom.pat: Hi! I'm Patguh. I live under a rock. I have a job too, you know: I lie down. Very well, even.
